title: DIA/NRO witness imaging objects in space

tellings.quote: And yet I have a disclosure project witness that worked for DIA and with and also NRO imaging these objects okay out in space

plain: The claim is that a man who worked for the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military spy service, and with the National Reconnaissance Office, which runs US spy satellites, photographed unexplained objects out in space. Steven Greer, who runs the Disclosure Project, a drive to collect testimony from insiders about UFOs, relays it from one of that project's unnamed witnesses. If true, US spy satellites would be imaging such objects in orbit.
